policy: Only services verified from first-party government sources may be promoted into this manifest. Conflicting official information must be represented conservatively and never guessed.

services.name: Aadhaar - Update Assistance
services.description: Guidance for current Aadhaar update options. UIDAI presently offers mobile-number and address updates in the Aadhaar app for supported cases; other changes may require myAadhaar or an Aadhaar centre. Clients complete OTP, face authentication and official payment themselves.
services.keywords: aadhaar,aadhar,uidai,aadhaar update,aadhar update,mobile number,address,document update,aadhaar app,my aadhaar

services.name: Aadhaar Mobile Number Update Assistance
services.description: Guidance for eligible Aadhaar mobile-number updates through the official Aadhaar app. Availability depends on UIDAI's current scenarios; clients complete OTP and face authentication themselves, and centre assistance is used when the official online flow is not available.
services.keywords: aadhaar mobile number update,aadhar phone number change,uidai mobile update,aadhaar app,phone link,mobile linking

services.name: Aadhaar Address Update Assistance
services.description: Guidance for Aadhaar address update through current UIDAI online/app options where eligible. The client completes Aadhaar authentication and any official payment directly with UIDAI.
services.keywords: aadhaar address update,aadhar address change,uidai address,my aadhaar,aadhaar app,address correction

services.name: Aadhaar Email Update Assistance
services.description: Guidance for Aadhaar email-address update when the current official Aadhaar mobile-app flow is available. UIDAI publications are evolving, so availability and charges must be rechecked before the client proceeds.
services.keywords: aadhaar email update,aadhar email change,uidai email,aadhaar app,email address

services.name: Aadhaar Document Update Assistance
services.description: Guidance for UIDAI's online document-update process where eligible. Current fee relaxation and eligibility are rechecked against UIDAI before submission.
services.keywords: aadhaar document update,my aadhaar,ssup,proof of identity,proof of address,uidai document update

services.name: e-Aadhaar Download Assistance
services.description: Guidance for downloading e-Aadhaar from UIDAI. The Aadhaar holder completes OTP/authentication themselves.
services.keywords: e-aadhaar download,aadhaar pdf,aadhar download,uidai download,aadhaar app,my aadhaar

services.name: Aadhaar Request Status Assistance
services.description: Guidance for checking the status of Aadhaar update and service requests through UIDAI's current status tools.
services.keywords: aadhaar status,aadhar update status,uidai track request,track my request,aadhaar app

services.name: Aadhaar Biometric Lock / Unlock Assistance
services.description: Guidance for using UIDAI's biometric lock/unlock security service. Authentication remains entirely with the Aadhaar holder.
services.keywords: aadhaar biometric lock,unlock biometrics,uidai security,aadhaar app,biometric lock unlock

services.name: Aadhaar PVC Card Order
services.description: Help with ordering an Aadhaar PVC card through the official UIDAI process. Clients complete OTP and payment directly with UIDAI.
services.keywords: aadhaar pvc,aadhar pvc,uidai,pvc card,aadhaar card order

services.name: PAN - Aadhaar Linking Assistance
services.description: Guidance for linking PAN with Aadhaar and checking link status through the official Income Tax e-Filing portal. Any applicable government fee and OTP are handled by the taxpayer on the official portal.
services.keywords: pan aadhaar link,link aadhaar,link pan aadhar,income tax e filing,pan aadhaar status
services.source_name: Income Tax Department Link Aadhaar manual

services.name: Passport - New Application
services.description: Assistance with passport application preparation and the official Passport Seva process. Passport application fees were revised from 1 July 2026, so the current official fee is confirmed before payment.

services.name: Passport - Renewal / Reissue
services.description: Assistance with eligible passport renewal/reissue applications through Passport Seva. Passport fees were revised from 1 July 2026, so the current official fee is confirmed before payment.
services.keywords: passport renewal,reissue,passport seva,expired passport,change particulars,passport fee
